groundTruth.rootCause: The recommendation service cache fails, so it leaks memory and slows down.
acceptableAlternatives: recommendation cache failure causing memory growth

hypothesis: Most likely cause: the recommendation service is slow and keeps restarting, and that is what raised frontend latency. Its product cache misses about half the time, which matches the recommendationCacheFailure flag: when it is on, the cache leaks memory and the service crash-loops. I could not read the flag's state directly, so this part is inferred. Recommendation p95 jumped from about 20 ms to 525 ms at 19:28, the moment the alert fired, and frontend p95 went from about 39 ms to 46 ms. I've proposed switching the flag off; nothing has been executed and it needs your approval.
